name: Welcome

props.description: Leading glyph. A STRING beginning with http(s) is rendered as a decorative (Ant Design X does the same, with alt="icon"); any other string renders as text.
props.name: icon

props.description: The greeting. Renders as an <h4>, which is Ant Design X's hardcoded Typography.Title level={4}.
props.name: title

props.description: Trailing slot on the TITLE row — a dismiss button, a model picker. Not under the description.
props.name: extra

props.description: filled gives the block its own tinted ground and hairline; borderless lets it sit on the page.
props.name: variant

related: EmptyState — the general 'nothing here yet' block for a list or a table. Welcome is the chat surface's greeting and carries an icon/title/description/extra shape of its own.
PageContainer — owns the PAGE header; Welcome sits inside the page body.
ChatSuggestion / ChatBubbleList — the rest of the same surface.
tagline: The greeting block at the head of an empty conversation (Ant Design X Welcome): glyph, greeting, one line under it, and a trailing slot ON THE TITLE ROW — which is the placement a hand-roll gets wrong.
usage: DO put it above the composer on an empty chat, with ChatSuggestion or a Prompts row beneath it — that is the surface it belongs to.
DO pass `extra` for the one action the greeting carries (dismiss, switch model). It lands beside the title, top-aligned, so a two-line title does not float it.
DON'T reach for it as a generic page header — that is PageContainer's title/subtitle/extra, which owns the page rhythm.
DON'T expect a heading-level prop: Ant Design X hardcodes level 4 and this ports that. Wrap it in your own heading hierarchy if the page needs a different rung.
DON'T expect `styles`/`classNames` from Ant Design X — retune through the --welcome-* tokens.
useCases: The first screen of an assistant, before the first message.
The head of a fresh conversation started from the Conversations rail.
A feature introduction card inside a chat surface, dismissed through `extra`.
